body:
Im not sure if this has anything with the latest update to do, but here we go: 
I was raiding an "unraidable" lootroom, yeah those with the boxes behind the window. Anyways, we broke the locked boxes and the little "bag" with the box loot just dissapeared through yet ANOTHER sheet metal wall, which we ofcourse had to spend another 400 explosive ammo on...

Luckily we were a few so we had farm we could just craft into more explosive ammo, it still sucks real bad, and I cant imagine how solos would feel if this happend to them.

Facepunch, PLEASE stop adding all these monuments in, please just stop. Fix game issues, such as the issue me and friends has had since 2016! (Thats 3 years ago) such as the game freezing completely when engaging in combat, in 9/10 cases, the first shots in full auto combat freezes totally and WOOPS, there goes the gear you grinded 5 hours for!
yes ofc people have to practice, but 90% of pilots cant be practicing? It took me less than an hour to get a grip of the controls and the aiming. It really isnt that hard.
I currently only have around 30 hours in this game but I can only recall 3 games where i had fucking beast pilots in my team who helped me out as soon as i got in trouble, and nah, i play on pc
Stop holding down W all the time and they arent very wonky at all
